label: Existence
resolution: V’s nonempty function, VI’s unique description and the modern ActualAt predicate have different types and truth conditions. The alternative individual predicate does not refute Russell inside his strict semantic restriction; quantifier truth is never silently read as a ground. EXISTENCE_4 (extranuclear existence of an object, Parsons-style reconstruction of Meinong) and EXISTENCE_5 (the watered-down nuclear property 'existent') are separate Lean declarations of a nuclear-property frame; the nuclear-characterization control shows that characterization confers EXISTENCE_5 and not EXISTENCE_4, so no argument passes from the one to the other without an explicit bridge. Neither is identified with EXISTENCE_1, EXISTENCE_2 or EXISTENCE_3. EXISTENCE_6 (exemplifying E!) and EXISTENCE_7 (encoding E!) are the two modes of an encoding/exemplification object theory in the style of Zalta; the encoding control shows that comprehension confers EXISTENCE_7 and not EXISTENCE_6. EXISTENCE_8 is a profile feature coextensive with existence at a world (an extensional surrogate of 'existence is a real predicate', satisfiable by accidental coextension); Kant's thesis denies that existence is a real predicate and treats it as positing, the instantiation sense EXISTENCE_1. The real-predicate control shows that EXISTENCE_8 suffices for 'most real implies exists' and that some model of the strengthened Kantian thesis with the identification and uniqueness premises has a most-real candidate and no existing most-real candidate, so those premises do not yield existence; no argument passes from EXISTENCE_1 or EXISTENCE_6 to EXISTENCE_8 without an explicit premise.
